front:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Crownforge Crown Guard modular character cutout atlas for continuous skeletal animation.
Primary request: Rebuild the bronze-armored blue-cloaked guard in reference 1 as refined, believable premium 3D-rendered historical-fantasy game art. Reference 2 shows ONLY the required sixteen-component layout; do not copy that woman's identity or clothing. Create exactly SIXTEEN individually isolated character pieces in a regular FOUR COLUMN by FOUR ROW grid. This is a production parts sheet, NOT a character turnaround, NOT whole figures and NOT repeated poses.
View: true FRONT view of the SAME guard, facing the viewer; modest orthographic 20-degree elevated camera. Every piece depicts the front-facing surfaces appropriate for a standing human in this view.
Identity: strong adult human Crown Guard, realistic natural proportions, handsome closed bronze Corinthian-style helmet with narrow eye opening and cheek guards, cobalt-blue horsehair crest, warm weathered bronze scale cuirass, restrained engraved sun ornament, blue cloth collar, dark blue linen under armor, matching segmented bronze shoulder armor, bronze vambraces and greaves, brown leather boots reinforced with bronze toes. Cloak is deep royal blue wool with restrained old-gold embroidered hem. Tactile aged bronze, crisp bevels, stitched leather, woven cloth. Refined realistic sculpted game artwork matching the quality of reference 2. Soft warm upper-left light and cool fill, clean readable silhouettes, no black outlines.
Exact row/column order, every complete piece comfortably inside its own cell with generous clear transparent gutters:
Row 1: (1) complete helmeted FRONT head with attached blue crest and short neck only; (2) FRONT sleeveless torso cuirass from neck to belt, with blue collar, NO head, arms, shoulder pieces or cloak; (3) FRONT hip armor skirt from belt to above knees, blue cloth and bronze hanging pteruges, NO legs; (4) ONE separate complete blue cloak, top neck attachment to knee-length hem, hanging straight in a relaxed natural fold, viewed from the FRONT inner surface, no body behind it.
Row 2: (1) anatomical LEFT upper arm including its bronze shoulder cap and short dark-blue sleeve, shoulder joint at TOP and elbow joint at BOTTOM; (2) anatomical RIGHT upper arm in matching armor, shoulder TOP elbow BOTTOM; (3) LEFT forearm with bronze vambrace, elbow TOP wrist BOTTOM, NO hand; (4) RIGHT forearm with bronze vambrace, elbow TOP wrist BOTTOM, NO hand.
Row 3: (1) LEFT hand with short wrist at TOP, loosely curled fingers at BOTTOM around an EMPTY invisible vertical handle, NO object; (2) RIGHT hand in the same natural neutral grip, wrist TOP fingers BOTTOM; (3) LEFT thigh from hip joint TOP to knee joint BOTTOM, dark fitted fabric and bronze thigh protection; (4) RIGHT thigh in matching armor, hip TOP knee BOTTOM.
Row 4: (1) LEFT shin with bronze greave, knee joint TOP ankle joint BOTTOM, NO foot; (2) RIGHT shin with bronze greave, knee TOP ankle BOTTOM, NO foot; (3) LEFT reinforced leather boot alone, ankle opening TOP, toes point toward viewer; (4) RIGHT matching boot alone, toes point toward viewer.
Rigging constraints: anatomical left/right are the character's own, NEVER screen-side labels. In FRONT view his left side would occupy the viewer's right when assembled. Left and right curled grips must be genuinely different correct hands, thumbs on their correct anatomical sides, wrist not twisted. Every limb segment hangs STRAIGHT DOWN with its joint-center axis vertically aligned, not bent or posed, rounded overlapping joint caps for assembly. Natural real anatomy, no dismemberment or internal anatomy. Hands have relaxed closed fingers and clear grip contact area; NO open flat palms.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent PNG alpha everywhere between components, no painted checkerboard. No background, no floor, no shadow discs.
Avoid: spear, shield, sword, tool, any object in a hand, baked equipment, whole character, extra parts, captions, labels, text, grid lines, scenery, cape attached to torso, duplicated head, cartoon exaggeration, tiny illegible busy decoration. All sixteen parts sharp and complete, none touching another cell.

directionVariants.right:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Crownforge Crown Guard modular sixteen-part skeletal animation atlas.
Primary request: Independently render the SAME original Crown Guard from the supplied modular FRONT reference, now in SCREEN-RIGHT side profile. Nose, chest and toes point toward the RIGHT edge. Right arm shows its lateral/outside surfaces, left arm shows medial/inside surfaces because this camera sees the character from his anatomical right. The hands are genuine anatomical left and right relaxed curled grips observed from this side, never duplicated flat front hands. Cloak is a narrow natural hanging side silhouette extending behind the torso toward screen-left; no wind-blown horizontal cape. Helmet plume sagittal profile is clearly visible. Every thigh, greave and boot is truly side-on pointing right.
Identity and material reference: reference1 is the new front modular artwork and defines the exact helmet, cobalt crest, bronze scale cuirass, deep blue cloth, bronze shoulder caps and vambraces, thigh armor, greaves, leather boots with bronze toe caps, and gold-trimmed blue cloak. Reference2 is the old complete guard only to confirm identity. Maintain the new premium realistic sculpted 3D-rendered look, warm upper-left light, cool fill, tasteful fine bronze scratches, clean detailed textile surfaces.
Layout: exact same FOUR-COLUMN FOUR-ROW sheet of SIXTEEN SEPARATE body components. Each part centered in its own cell, complete and isolated with generous blank transparent margins. No text or printed grid. This is a rigging asset library, never a complete figure or pose sheet.
Required index order:
Row1: helmeted head with crest and short neck only / sleeveless torso from neck to belt NO head arms or cloak / separate belt-and-hip armor skirt NO legs / ONE separate complete cloak from neck to knee hem.
Row2: anatomical LEFT upper arm with shoulder cap, shoulder TOP elbow BOTTOM / RIGHT upper arm / LEFT forearm, elbow TOP wrist BOTTOM and NO hand / RIGHT forearm.
Row3: LEFT curled empty gripping hand with wrist TOP and fingers BOTTOM / RIGHT curled empty gripping hand / ONE LEFT thigh hip TOP knee BOTTOM / ONE RIGHT thigh hip TOP knee BOTTOM.
Row4: LEFT shin knee TOP ankle BOTTOM NO foot / RIGHT shin NO foot / LEFT boot alone ankle opening TOP / RIGHT boot alone.
Anatomy: preserve anatomical left/right, independently authored surfaces appropriate to this view; do not mirror an image. Every limb joint-center axis points vertically DOWN, neutral straight unbent assembly segments with rounded overlapping caps. Hands close loosely around an EMPTY invisible vertical handle; no open splayed palm, no tool, no spear, no shield. One individual thigh per thigh cell, never a pair of shorts. Every piece uses the specified camera direction, including both feet and both hands.
Background: genuine transparent alpha PNG, all blank areas alpha zero, no painted checkerboard, matte, scenery, floor, labels, shadow discs or whole characters. No weapon, shield, baked equipment, or cloak attached to torso. Keep every piece within its own cell.

transparentExtraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet.
Primary request: Extract all sixteen separate Crown Guard character components from the supplied sheet onto a genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel.
Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep every component and its placement, detail, color, anatomical side, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the painted checkerboard background. Preserve clean edges, cloth gaps, helmet openings and all empty space. The output must be a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on checkerboard paper. Do not add, mirror, relight, combine or repaint any component.
constraints: Spear and sun shield are separate runtime equipment; no image mirroring or script edits to generated PNG pixels.
